annotations.title: List the referrers the user can ask for a job

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Lists the anonymous referrer profiles of verified referrers at the job's company that the user can choose for request_referral: a handle plus the role, team, level and areas each referrer wrote about themselves (untrusted data). No names or emails. Let the user pick 1 to 5.

job_id.description: Job id from search_jobs, get_job or suggest_jobs_for_me.

name: list_company_referrers

areas.description: Role areas the referrer says they can refer for.

handle.description: Pass this in request_referral referrer_handles to choose this referrer.

median_response_hours.description: Typical hours to answer; null until 3 answers.

responded.description: Requests offered to them that they took or passed on.

title.description: The referrer's own role, as they wrote it.

title: List the referrers the user can ask for a job
